touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Blyton qualifies as a local detour through CHURCH OF ST MARTIN and Cross in St Martin's churchyard. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Blyton: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Blyton offers CHURCH OF ST MARTIN, Cross in St Martin's churchyard, THE OLD WINDMILL within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: CHURCH OF ST MARTIN
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with CHURCH OF ST MARTIN and Cross in St Martin's churchyard, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
